Title: Lasagna
ShortSummary: Lasagna, pasta dish of Italian origin, made with broad often ruffled noodles and a tomato or white sauce.

Title: Pasta Carbonara
ShortSummary: Carbonara is a pasta dish made with cured pork, hard cheese, eggs, salt, and black pepper. It is typical of the Lazio region of Italy.

Title: Pizza Margherita
ShortSummary: Pizza Margherita is a classic Neapolitan pizza topped with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, fresh basil, and a drizzle of olive oil.

Title: Tiramisu
ShortSummary: Tiramisu is an Italian dessert made with coffee-soaked ladyfingers (savoiardi) covered with a cream of egg yolks, sugar, mascarpone, and cocoa powder.

Title: Risotto alla Milanese
ShortSummary: Risotto alla Milanese is a classic, golden-colored Italian risotto from Milan, Lombardy.
